note: Invented public-style messages and call scripts for the Scam Shield evaluation (v2: links, calls, WhatsApp, Urdu / Roman Urdu). Mock phone numbers and domains only; 8171 / 0800-26477 appear as real-world short-code patterns. Not collected from real people.
